body:
Lupine Discovery provides an exact conditional candidate-pool engine, six-mode local workbench, independent known-answer controls and reproducible archived evaluations. Historical scientific failures remain visible. Physical validity and general predictive superiority are not established.

Commit c17c4c6 adds separate bounded growth-hint and envelope readers while preserving all 326 earlier runtime files. The first combined Li run passes 359 tests with332 source files held. G30 passes 35 author/21 independent tests and 472 complete synthetic report comparisons. G31 passes 31 author/24 independent tests after preserving an inherited central-directory declared-length failure and its unchanged regression fixture. A raw bounded preflight closes that gap; this is a generated software finding, not an actual-archive defect claim.

Clean packaging at exact c17c4c6 passes 28 demonstrations, six schemas and 16 installed checks, followed by strict retention. Its own original-push [CI 38888807101](https://github.com/alexwelcing/lupine/actions/runs/38888807101) and independent artifact audits are pending. Neither new reader has performed its actual fixed operation. The preceding report-only 2428c313 passed all four original CI jobs.

The latest verified actual Li checkpoint remains d0505b9: after all four CI jobs, clean package and independent audits, two identical BLOCKED_SCHEMA / LOCAL_EXTRA_HEADERS_COMPLETE receipts identify one 0xA220 field of 516 declared data bytes in the selected local area. Independent public-receipt audit passed 11,189 checks. The whole raw buffer and directory metadata were read, but field payloads were uninterpreted and no member/XML/worksheet was decoded at that checkpoint. New G30/G31 gates remain distinct.

BAM schema documentation was parsed under two explicitly hypothetical single-byte codecs following the preserved UTF-8 failure; no encoding was promoted as authoritative. Partial definitions do not establish uncertainty budgets or independent units. Li count/version differences, source reuse, curation and citation conflicts remain unresolved. No new scientific protocol, allocation, fit, DFT or exposed-set tuning occurred. MPEA, JARVIS, interval-pilot and training-only NO-GO results remain unchanged. The expired bounded automation stays disabled.

Evidence: discovery/GOAL.md, discovery/STATUS.md, discovery/reports/phase2-growth-implementation-v1/PUBLICATION.md, discovery/reports/phase2-bam-encoding-comparison-v1/PUBLICATION.md and discovery/docs/release-validation.md.
